holidays.name: International Fairy Day
holidays.description: A day for believing in the little winged folk. Fans trade garden-fairy crafts, leave tiny offerings among the flowers, wear glitter and wings, and read fairy tales. It lands near Midsummer, when folklore says the veil between worlds is thinnest.
holidays.origin: An unofficial observance of unclear origin. It is widely linked to Midsummer traditions, which have long associated this time of year with fairies and nature spirits.
holidays.funFact: In Celtic and Scandinavian folklore, Midsummer is a prime time for fairy activity. People once left out milk or honey, or hung protective herbs, to keep the fairies friendly.

holidays.name: World UFO Day
holidays.description: A day for skywatchers, sci-fi fans and curious minds. Enthusiasts hold stargazing parties, share sighting stories, and wonder whether we are alone in the universe. Tinfoil hats are optional but encouraged.
holidays.origin: June 24 marks the anniversary of pilot Kenneth Arnold's 1947 report of nine shiny objects flying near Mount Rainier in Washington. The press coined the term 'flying saucer' from his description, which kicked off the modern UFO craze. Some groups celebrate on July 2 instead, to honor the Roswell incident.
holidays.funFact: Arnold said the objects moved like a saucer skipping across water. Reporters turned that into 'flying saucers', even though the objects he described were actually crescent-shaped.

holidays.name: National Take Back the Lunch Break Day
holidays.description: A rebellion against eating at your desk. People are encouraged to step away from their screens, go outside, and actually enjoy a real lunch hour. Your sad desk salad is on notice.
holidays.origin: This awareness day was created to encourage workers to take proper midday breaks, in response to the growing habit of working straight through lunch.
holidays.funFact: Surveys on workplace habits have repeatedly found that a large share of employees regularly eat lunch at their desks instead of taking a real break.
